study_type_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic profiles of FITC-AAR029b and liposome encapsulated FITC-AAR029b were determined in Sprague-Dawley rats (200-250 g; 2 animals in two groups).
we compared the serum in vitro stability of the cPT HIV-1 inactivator AAR029b, the fluorescein-labeled AAR029b (FITC-AAR029b), and a linear PT UM15

in_vivo_species.quote: Sprague-Dawley rats (200-250 g; 2 animals in two groups)

ex_vivo_detail: Serum stability comparison of AAR029b, FITC-AAR029b and linear PT UM15.

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: the plasma level of free FITC-AAR029b, determined by fluorescence measurements ... decreased more rapidly and was not detectable beyond 7 hours
concentration_time_figure.note: Free cPT undetectable beyond 7 h; liposomal formulation detectable over 24 h.

bioanalytical_method: Plasma fluorescence (ex 494 nm, em 520 nm) against a FITC-AAR029b calibration curve, with UPLC-Q-TOF MS confirmation that the signal is intact FITC-AAR029b rather than free FITC or fragments
bioanalytical_quote: selected plasma samples were analyzed by Q-TOF mass spectrometry to confirm that fluorescence measurements were directly correlated to intact FITC-AAR029b and not due to free FITC or FITC-peptide fragments
notes: All four PEPlife2 values match the body: elimination 2.92 ± 0.93 h (free) and 8.87 ± 3.17 h (liposomal), distribution 0.029 ± 0.01 and 0.032 ± 0.005 h. Two cautions. (1) n = 2 ANIMALS in total, two per group, run in duplicate - the SD of ±3.17 on the 8.87 h liposomal value spans more than a third of the mean, and no meaningful precision should be read into these numbers. (2) PEPlife2 leaves the Sequence field EMPTY on the two distribution-phase rows while filling it on the two elimination rows, although all four describe the same molecule; the empty rows will be dropped by any sequence-requiring filter, so this study contributes only its two elimination values downstream. Unlike a peptide-targeted carrier, the measured analyte here IS the peptide (fluorescence confirmed as intact FITC-AAR029b by Q-TOF), so the liposomal value is a legitimate peptide half-life. The body reports no dose in mg/kg, only 3 μg fluorescein equivalent.
